name: How long does it take to replace foggy sliding door glass?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to replace foggy sliding door glass?

acceptedAnswer.text: The total time to replace foggy sliding door glass involves two main phases: ordering the custom glass and the installation itself. Once measurements are taken, the custom insulated glass unit (IGU) can take several days to a few weeks to be fabricated, depending on current demand and glass specifications. The actual installation by our technicians typically takes a few hours per door. We aim to minimize disruption to your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom glass fabrication can take days to weeks, while the installation typically takes a few hours per door. We will provide an estimated timeline during your consultation.
